verdict.rationale: AMD's GAIA framework, which runs 'AI agents' locally on this hardware, is explicitly agent/natural-language oriented, and the Lemonade SDK/LLM stack let users run and query LLMs on-chip — but this is ecosystem software layered on the silicon, not the chip itself being 'operated' via natural-language commands, and no evidence shows a direct NL command interface to configure or control the processor. missing for 10: a native NL command interface for the product itself, hands-on evidence of GAIA/agent natural-language control working end-to-end, independent corroboration beyond AMD's own docs.
